RagShortTexts: White Lake settlements depend on fish, forest products and seasonally changing water routes.
Boats, nets and food stores sustain winter life alongside exchange with other districts.

Variants.Content: Beloozero draws on White Lake fisheries, forest products and waterways. Open-water carriage and winter travel need different preparations; break-up and freeze-up make journeys uncertain. Money alone cannot replace boatmen, lodging and food. Local authority depends on supplies arriving from scattered settlements.

Fishing households mend nets, tend boats and store winter food. A traveler takes labor away from fishing and carriage. Purchasers bring useful goods, while requisitioned boats may miss fishing days. Uncertain ice makes a trusted route worth waiting for rather than risking the household's craft and catch.
